name: Cambie Bridge
elevationDatum: Local metres east/up/south; y=0 is flat-map/water grade. Estimated 18.5 m marine deck (published marine clearance 14 m); world absolute-deck policy fits the separate bank approaches and each support foot to resident DEM. No DEM baked into source.
note: 1985 twin prestressed concrete spine/box girders, tan volcanic-ash concrete, flared piers, 4.3 m east multi-use path and 1.8 m west sidewalk. Published total structural length 1100 m and span range 33–84 m; individual supports, depth and heights are visual/map estimates. Original six-lane envelope; current OSM five motor lanes plus west protected cycle lane. Both main north approaches are authored; small interchange ramps remain provider geometry.
